2300 TEXT  ·  Spring 202702 — Attendance & recitations
02 — Attendance

Attendance:

Much like other purchases—you will find yourself responsible for the quality of your experience.

My responsibility is to many students—I expect that if you want to know what this whole typography thing is about, you’re going to show up on time—all the time. If you think this might not be the right time for this class consider doing this another time.

If you are found absent more than twice you will be ineligible for an A grade. More than 3 times you would be ineligible for a C.

How absences add up

0
A possible
1
A possible
2
A possible
3
No A
4+
No C
02 — At recitations

At
Recitations:

The LA will be responsible for delivering a synopsis of the course. You will receive a handout.

  1. You will pick up an assignment that you can perform during that period. Sign and place the assignment in the folder on your way out of the room.
  2. Each recitation assignment is also an attendance mechanism.
  3. If the recitation has a reading and discussion assignment. This Happens during the session and the text is read out loud with everyone present. Each person reads one or two paragraphs. Each person writes a 2 sentence synopsis. by hand.
  4. Each recitation has a practice which you can participate with as long as you please.
  5. If it is a quiz the quiz can refer to any source. All quizzes are to be handed in before you leave.
  6. The work you make must be handed in before you leave the room.
  7. There are no late assignments for the recitations don’t ask for extensions due to absence.
  8. 10 Assignments will be accepted of a possible 15 assignments during the semester.

MA ONE · Due Feb 1Hand Drawn Letters

Draw with some accuracy and fidelity the following letters, (ALL LETTERS) each in the sizes stated below (ALL SIZES), in three of the typefaces stated below. (CHOOSE 3.)

Provide a 2 sentence biography of the designers of any typefaces you choose.

Use any tool you wish and only that tool.
1 color only excluding paper colors.

MAJUSCULE: CAPITAL: UPPERCASE:

B Q K Y

MINUSCULE: COMMON: LOWERCASE:

a g p y

NUMBER: NUMERAL: DIGIT:

any Numeral you choose

SIZES IN PTS. and PICAS

36 72 222 450 PTS / 25 PICAS

TYPEFACES  (CHOOSE 3.)

  • Bodoni Extra Bold Italic
  • Trade Gothic Condensed 20 (BOLD)
  • Baskerville Italic
  • Garamond Roman
  • Interstate Gothic
  • Futura Extra Bold

This assignment is to be performed during the recitation, and also where ever the student is most comfortable. During the recitation the LA will help guide research for the student group and general solutions for tools and expectations.

There are 150 Drawings which can be made into any artifact the student would like, a book, a poster, a stack of uncoordinated papers. Whatever.

The B grade is getting it done. The A grade makes it interesting.

MA TWO · Due Feb 22NUMBERS and Statistics

Pull 1 Statistic from each of the following:

Fin Tech
Financial Times(Online or Newspaper. Provide citation)
Op Ed.
New York Times(Online or Newspaper. Provide citation)
Sports
ESPN(TV, Provide photo citation)
When complete there will be 3 separate decks.
All narratives are factual.
There must be evidence to support any inference.
Upload the work to canvas.

Produce (3) 4 Slide Decks to sell any aspect of the research. Recreate a branded template for the author of each deck. Each deck is from a different author position. Pro/Con/Neutral.

Pro
Con
Neutral

This is an assignment at the intersection of speculative futures and storytelling using—more or less—accepted forms of source material and retold and cited for the purposes of promoting a favorable/unfavorable circumstance and the consequences that are in the truth of this ‘fact’. Numbers are central to this work. There must be a number story.

Use AI at your own risk. AI errors are common, if the AI errors are present in your finished work. Your final grade for the assignment will drop by a full letter grade.
Example

A 4 Slide deck produced from a piece of information found in an ESPN report about the inbound trend of ‘AthleisureWear’. The statistic might support investment in a ‘breathable textile startup’. The author might be a tech/textile company selling the investment opportunity. Located in Jaipur, Northern India. With more than one technical fabric in its portfolio.
